summary: Fortress Biotech filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing that on September 30, 2026 it repaid in full the remaining $15.0 million principal outstanding under its $50.0 million senior secured credit agreement with Oaktree Fund Administration, LLC, plus roughly $435,000 accrued interest, a $150,000 prepayment fee and other closing costs. All indebtedness was satisfied, liens and security interests released, and the agreement automatically terminated. No board recommendation, advisor, premium or per-share terms were disclosed. Watch deleveraging impact on liquidity and pipeline funding risk.
